summary: Independent nonauthor Gemini 4 Argon (High) source/UI/copy audit of the Moriarty Webs v4 depth-revision candidate (artifactSha256 b71e79b19f68e49634e7d7593fa415900d22b0ddf8fb5ab02016138c4136b920). All 31 files in MANIFEST.json (plus MANIFEST.json itself) were inspected. The candidate resolves the reader-study complaints with substantive, clear prose and distinct quantitative diagrams: (1) shared invoice arithmetic in app/src/invoice.mjs and DepthContent.jsx conserves 112 = 35 + 2 + 75 with continuing duties 65 + 10 = 75, keeps the source 110 opening distinct (leaving 73 cash against 75 duties, a 2 CASH backing gap), and separates the checked-in request scenario (109/90/14 leaving 72/55/14); (2) the invoice walkthrough and TransactionDiagram model one whole-execution Strand covering three conditions producing one Issue claim output consumed by one settlement transaction, never three proof producers; (3) the other four application models are financially distinct without fabricating unprovided pool reserves, rate schedules, datum layouts, signer matrices, or ADA costs (DEX two 100 A orders with 90 B floors and 92 B net receipts sharing an unspecified pool transition; Issuance 300 = 180 + 120 under a 1,000 cap with 700 unissued capacity explicitly distinguished from debt and payments; Loan 100 + 5 - 35 = 70 remaining duty versus 37 CASH gross payer debit; Treasury allocate(true,23,7,2) paying 14 + 7 + 2 = 23 A and 4 B, retaining 2 A and 6 B custody against 2 A remainder reserve duty and 6 B rebate duty, with fixed 2 A fee distinct from remainder); (4) actual Moriarty partial source and moriarty-k2-relation-selector/1 JSON are exposed; (5) offchain preparation (authorize, prove, assemble) is separated from onchain Issue, settlement, and post-expiry reclaim; (6) Groth16 setup counting per distinct compiled relation (with predicate_digest as a circuit constant in current source vs free context/body wires) and local forgeable test-setup limits are preserved alongside original technical evidence; and (7) ConcernGraph.jsx renders an undirected neighborhood with native button controls and a polite live region rather than a false directed execution pipeline. No blocking or major issues were found within the assigned scope; one medium responsive CSS issue on mobile tables and four low-severity copy/code items (including one Opus security-wording referral) are reported.
